semanticDecisions: Candidate verdict CANNOT_MATCH is the only claim checked: it must imply find == false; MAY_MATCH is never wrong
Report retains the first maxRetained contradictions in (regex, input) order and derives its root from every count and row; a mismatching root is refused
oracleRoot binds MATRIX_ROOT to the ten shard image roots (outcomes and signals); it is pinned in the test and any drift on a later JDK is reported, not silently accepted
the corpus is not a Pattern replacement proof and the harness makes no timing or runtime claim
